text:
sam: Heads-up - Aurelia wants to scale to 50 seats. Procurement is asking for a 6mo discounted pilot that auto-converts to 12mo. Need acceptance path by EOD to hold SE enablement next week.
rachel: Any discount number from buyer?
sam: They asked for 25% off the pilot.
priya: Finance concern: 25% + short pilot = churn risk. Recommend partial upfront.
finance: prefer 75% upfront for pilot if discount >20%. Otherwise 50% OK with card-on-file.
contracts-bot: Delegated signing allowed if PO names the delegate or a Delegation of Authority is provided. Recommend 1-pg Delegation Addendum for speed.
procurement-team: We can accept a scanned PO with named delegated signer as interim. Drafting PO template with delegated-signer field, ETA 60m.
onboard-lead: SE slot next week (Apr 5-9) needs confirmation by EOD, otherwise moves 2 weeks. We can compress onboarding to 3 days if needed.
sam: I'll send two options to buyer: (A) 6mo @ -25% pilot, 50% upfront + card-on-file, Delegation Addendum or PO scan, tentative SE hold; (B) immediate annual at list price with 100% upfront and guaranteed SE week.
rachel: I'll prep Delegation Addendum and short amendment language for conversion billing (auto-charge + proration rules).
priya: If buyer picks A, finance needs card-on-file or signed autorenew invoice mechanics.
procurement-team: PO draft sent to sam@aurelia.com with delegated-signer checkbox + vendor code.
sam: Buyer replied: "Option A preferred, CFO traveling Tue-Wed. Procurement can sign. Can we accept PO scan and get Delegation form after?"
contracts-bot: Acceptable as interim: PO scan with named delegate, but require Delegation Addendum executed within 3 business days. Include fallback: pause conversion if not received.
sam: Great. Action items: 1) send Option A + PO template + Delegation Addendum 2) reserve SE Apr5-9 tentatively 3) finance to confirm 50% vs 75% upfront concession 4) procurement to route PO scan to billing.
finance: Confirming 50% upfront + card-on-file for Option A is acceptable. We will approve 25% pilot discount with that protection.
onboard-lead: I'll tentatively hold resources and prep a condensed agenda + prework pack.
sam: Thanks team. I'll update the thread once PO scan or addendum arrives. :thumbsup:
